reasons.arbitrary-modifier: An arbitrary value takes a modifier too: text-[18.2px]/7 sets font-size and line-height. Engine gap: modifiers are only tried on indexed utilities.
reasons.bg: background-size and background-position have their own roots (bg-size-[…], bg-position-[…]); we write a type-hinted or ambiguous bg-[…]. Engine gap: type-hint choice.
reasons.calc: Tailwind spells math operators inside calc() without spaces (it adds them back when compiling); our encoding writes them as `_+_`. Cosmetic.
reasons.fallback: var(--x, fallback) has the variable shorthand root-(--x,fallback). Engine gap: variable forms are only tried for a plain var(--x).
reasons.leading: line-height: 0 stays apart from leading-0 (calc(var(--spacing) * 0) is 0px): unitless numbers and lengths are different normal forms for line-height (N11). Intentionally stricter.
reasons.modifier: A var() line-height modifier has the shorthand text-base/(--x). Engine gap: modifier variables are written as /[var(--x)].
reasons.negative: calc(var(--x) * -1) has the negative variable form -mt-(--x). Engine gap: negative roots are not tried with variables.
reasons.variant: Variant spelling: Tailwind shortens [&:is(…)]: to […]: and not-[[aria-x=…]]: to not-aria-[x=…]:. Cosmetic.
reasons.whole: A shorthand kept whole (N01: a var() value) becomes an arbitrary property; Tailwind has a functional root that takes the whole value (p-[…], m-[…], rounded-(…), border-(…), filter-[…]). Engine gap: functional roots are not tried for whole shorthands.
